title: ConfirmContent no longer owns focus; caller supplies refs for initialFocus
answers: Where should I add focus logic for a new confirm-modal variant
Should ConfirmContent focus its own input or button
How is initial focus decided between the confirm button and the type-to-confirm input
body:
Convention: ConfirmContent itself must not manage which element receives focus on mount — it only forwards `confirmButtonRef`/`confirmPromptRef` props to the underlying <Button>/<Input> via `ref`. The decision of which ref to focus (button vs. type-to-confirm input) is made by the parent (ConfirmModal), which picks `confirmPromptRef` when `confirmationText && !disabled`, else `confirmButtonRef`, and passes that single ref to Modal's `initialFocus` prop.
Fix pattern/invariant: any new type-to-confirm or conditional-focus logic added to ConfirmContent should extend the parent's initialFocus selection, not re-introduce a local useEffect that calls `.focus()` — doing so reintroduces the dropdown-vs-modal focus race.
Constraints: applies to ConfirmContent/ConfirmModal specifically; other grafana-ui modal content components that render inside <Modal> should follow the same ref-up, initialFocus-down pattern when they need initial focus different from Modal's default.
applies: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/* when adding new focus-sensitive fields or buttons.

search: ConfirmContent must not manage focus on mount; the parent ConfirmModal selects which ref (confirmPromptRef for type-to-confirm, confirmButtonRef otherwise) to pass to Modal's initialFocus prop. ConfirmContent only forwards confirmButtonRef and confirmPromptRef to underlying <Button>/<Input> elements via ref prop, delegating focus decisions upward. Fix pattern: extend parent's initialFocus selection logic rather than re-introducing useEffect with .focus() calls, which reintroduces the dropdown-vs-modal focus race. Applies when adding focus-sensitive fields or buttons to ConfirmContent or implementing similar ref-forwarding patterns in other grafana-ui modal components. Paths: packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmModal.tsx, packages/grafana-ui/src/components/ConfirmModal/ConfirmContent.tsx.
